posts.title: CSS 3D Lab: 168 3D models, no WebGL
posts.summary: 168 3D models in pure CSS, how each one works, and code you can paste anywhere.

images.label: CSS 3D Lab
images.alt: CSS 3D Lab: 3D on the web, no WebGL required.

text.kofi:
A free gallery of 168 3D models built with CSS. Each one runs live, explains how it works, and gives you a snippet to paste into any project. No build step.

• 120 are pure CSS, zero JavaScript
• 48 use JS only to feed in values like pointer position; CSS still renders
• The code windows are live editors
• Export any model as MP4, WebM, PNG or JPEG

What you copy is exactly what runs on the site. No hidden second version.

Try it: css3dlab.edgarasneverdauskas.com
Code: github.com/Evirtual/css-3d-lab

If it saved you a fight with preserve-3d, a coffee keeps the domain up.

posts.title: JARVIS: a console that talks back, with real numbers
posts.summary: A console that talks back, where every number on screen is measured, not simulated.

images.label: JARVIS
images.alt: J.A.R.V.I.S., a console that talks back.

text.kofi:
An Iron Man–style console you can talk to. Every figure on screen is measured, not simulated: your real CPU, GPU temperatures, network devices and weather.

• Speak or type, and he answers out loud
• Research lives as threads on a board
• Web search with sources, pictures and video
• Runs on your own Gemini (free tier) or ChatGPT key

Open it in the browser, or run it on your PC for full readings.

Try it: jarvis.edgarasneverdauskas.com
Code: github.com/Evirtual/jarvis

Your key pays for your answers. A coffee covers my part: the domain and hosting.

text.linkedin:
JARVIS is an Iron Man–style console you can talk to, built around one rule: every figure on screen is measured, not simulated. Real CPU cores, real GPU temperatures, the real devices on your network, the real weather where you are.

You speak or type, and answers stream in and are spoken as they're written. Research lives as threads on a board you can group, link and tidy by voice. Web search brings back sources, pictures and video inside the thread.

It runs on your own key: Gemini, which has a free tier, or ChatGPT. Connect both and it falls back from one to the other, and says why.

Try it in the browser: https://jarvis.edgarasneverdauskas.com
Code (AGPL-3.0): https://github.com/Evirtual/jarvis
